props.name: name
props.description: Person or brand the avatar stands for. Used as the accessible name and for the initials.

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL. Omitted (or failing to load) = initials from `name`.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` 30px for post headers, `md` 44px for lists, `lg` 84px with a rim ring for profile headers.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Set when a visible name sits right next to the avatar, so screen readers don't hear it twice.

props.name: tone
props.description: `neutral` is a glass ring. `info`, `positive`, `warning` and `critical` are solid status fills, each at least 4.5:1 with its text.

props.name: dot
props.description: Show a leading dot, a shape cue on top of the colour.

props.name: children
props.description: The status in words, e.g. "Live", "3 new", "Failed".

props.name: tone
props.description: The tone. Each has its own glyph shape (circle, check, triangle, octagon) and its spoken word, so colour is never the only cue.

props.name: title
props.description: One line saying what happened.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional detail saying what it means or what to do. Shown under the title.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional action at the end of the line, normally a quiet Button. Use the loud solid only when acting on this message is the pane's main task.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a Dismiss button. Called after the line has closed, so remove the banner from state here.

props.name: live
props.description:
Announce it when it appears. 'polite' gives role="status" and 'assertive' gives role="alert".
Leave it unset for banners already present on page load, since announcing those interrupts for nothing.

props.name: variant
props.description: `light` = solid white pill, the one main action on a card. `accent` = blue. `glass` = quiet fill.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` = 44px tall (default, touch-friendly); `sm` = 32px for dense rows and toolbars.

props.name: variant
props.description: `glass` = a floating pane. `inset` = content nested inside a pane (no second glass layer, top divider).

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered element. Use `article` for self-contained content, `section` for a titled region, `aside` for complementary content and `header` for a page head.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL; omit for a decorative gradient placeholder.

props.name: label
props.description: The choice in words. Clicking it toggles the box, and it is the box's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional secondary line under the label.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. `'indeterminate'` shows a dash for a parent of mixed children.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Starting state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted when checked. Defaults to "on".

props.name: children
props.description: The chip's label, which is also its accessible name.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selection (filter chips). Selection is carried by aria-pressed and a check mark, never colour alone.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial selection when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the new selection.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Makes it an input chip with a remove button named "Remove {label}".

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Plain-text label for the remove button's name, when children is not plain text.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum width. sm is 640px, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1200 (the default) and 2xl 1440.

props.name: brightness
props.description:
How bright the world behind the glass is (D-009). Glass inside darkens to keep text ≥4.5:1.
Size it for the brightest spot a card can land on, not the scene's average. Default `bright`.

props.name: legend
props.description: The group's name, read before every control in it.

props.name: help
props.description: Optional help for the whole group, under the legend.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's name, shown above the control and used as its accessible name.

props.name: help
props.description: Optional help shown under the control and read after the label.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message. Setting it marks the control invalid and shows the error under it.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required. The label says (required) in words, never with a colour or an asterisk alone.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control inside.

props.name: children
props.description: The control, usually one Input, Textarea or PinInput.

props.name: columns
props.description: Override the column count. By default it follows the layout tokens, which give 4, then 8 at md (768px), then 12 at lg (1024px).

props.name: span
props.description: Columns to span below md (and above, unless md/lg are set). 'full' = every column.

props.name: md
props.description: Columns to span from the md breakpoint (768px).

props.name: lg
props.description: Columns to span from the lg breakpoint (1024px).

props.name: tone
props.description: `help` is secondary text. `error` adds the octagon glyph and the spoken word Error, so the tone is never colour alone.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required, because an icon has no text and this is the button's whole accessible name.

props.name: variant
props.description: `glass` = round frosted disc. `ghost` = icon only, for dense rows (actions, overflow).

props.name: size
props.description: `md` = 36px disc; `sm` = 32px for action rows.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` is 44px tall for touch (default); `sm` is 32px for dense toolbars, below the 44px touch size.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as wrong. Inside a FormField, its `error` sets this for you.

props.name: start
props.description: Shown before the input inside the same well, such as a search icon or a currency. Decorative unless it is a control.

props.name: end
props.description: Shown after the input inside the same well, such as a unit or a small Button.

props.name: children
props.description: One Input.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds "(required)" after the text, in words, so the state is never shown by colour alone.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of cells, usually 4 or 6.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value, as a string of up to `length` characters.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole code on every change.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once every cell is filled.

props.name: type
props.description: `numeric` (default) shows the number keyboard on phones and accepts digits only.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the group when it is not inside a FormField, such as "Verification code".

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the code as wrong. Inside a FormField, its `error` sets this for you.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for form submission; the code is submitted as one value.

props.name: label
props.description: The question the group answers, shown above the options and used as the group's name.

props.name: help
props.description: Optional help under the label.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen value.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for form submission.

props.name: children
props.description: The Radio options.

props.name: value
props.description: The value this option reports.

props.name: label
props.description: The option in words, also its accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional secondary line.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, also the control's accessible name. Required: a select without a name is unusable with a screen reader.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Keep the label for assistive tech but do not show it, when the context already names the control.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, in display order.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when the reader picks an option.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown when nothing is selected.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` is 44px tall for touch; `sm` is 32px for toolbars and dense forms.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled behaviour: not focusable, cannot open.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for form submission.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the wrapper.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, also the slider's accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every change while dragging or pressing keys.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest value. Defaults to 0.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value. Defaults to 100.

props.name: step
props.description: Step between values. Defaults to 1.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the value shown next to the label and spoken by screen readers, e.g. `(v) => \`${v}px\``.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native-like disabled behaviour.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the wrapper.

props.name: direction
props.description: `column` (default) stacks vertically; `row` lays out inline and wraps.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children. xs is 4px, sm 8, md 16 (the default), lg 24 and xl 32.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: label
props.description: The setting in words, also the switch's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional secondary line, such as what turning it on does.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Starting state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state. A switch applies at once, so save here.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for form submission.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, written in normal case. CSS uppercases it, so screen readers still read words.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as wrong. Inside a FormField, its `error` sets this for you.
